summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2022-C15 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to disclose the removal of KeyBank National Association as special servicer of the 26 Broadway Mortgage Loan and the appointment of Green Loan Services LLC as successor special servicer under the BWAY 2022-26BW trust and servicing agreement. The loan represents approximately 3.3% of the asset pool. This is a routine servicing administration update for a commercial mortgage-backed securities trust, not a special situation. No deal terms, financial details, or structural changes are involved. Watch for any future servicing-related disclosures, but there is no transaction or strategic event to analyze.
